verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution for accepting contactless in-person payments with the phone as the payment interface. Its marketing page says compatible smartphones or tablets become Tap to Pay checkouts with no extra hardware required, which covers the no-reader part of the story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Android/non-iPhone Tap to Pay and on onboarding or setup effort for a founder without a custom integration, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: With our Tap to Pay on iPhone solution you can accept contactless in-person payments using an iPhone as the payment interface, and process these payments on the Adyen payments platform.
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
